Baptist Health Shelby Hospital has been a part of Baptist Health (AL) since before 2021. Here is evidence about Baptist Health (AL)’s adoption of Workday: Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Baptist Health (AL) and Workday:

  • Confirmation of Workday Implementation: Several sources confirm that Baptist Health (AL) either has Workday or is in the process of implementing it.

    • [10] makes mention of a Workday login for employees of Baptist Health as well as training.

It appears that Baptist Health (AL) has been implementing Workday Financial Management, Workday Human Capital Management (HCM), and Workday Adaptive Planning. The implementation may have been in progress around 2022, driving the timeline for their LMS implementation, and with modules being selected as recently as May 2024.
